title: Is Skyrim Worth It in 2026? $1.14 an Hour
caption:
Skyrim is $39.99 on Steam and takes about 35 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): $1.14 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 240 hours) and it drops to 17¢ an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 hours in Skyrim. The main quest costs you $1.14 an hour.
